snippet.title: Grieving Trailer
snippet.description:
A story about the mystery of a boarding room inhabited by a supernatural being, where its caretaker is required to perform a mourning ritual.

Rocky, who has just returned from work, is asked by his grandfather to look after the boarding house. However, the haunted room forces Rocky to carry out the ritual on his own.

The ghost, known as “The Girl,” wants to share something she has been keeping inside, and you are forced to follow her will for her own sake.

What is really happening? Who is the ghost? And why does it keep haunting the boarding house?
